nui 1
record Seed(n: number)
record Shape(p: path, n: number)
module Make(p: path, q: path, n: number, present: boolean) {
 const A: Seed = Seed(n: @n)
 const B: Seed = Seed(n: @n + 100)
 const Values: Seed[] = [@A]
 const Fallback: Seed[] = [@B]
 const Maybe: Seed[]? = if (@present) { @Values }
 const Source: Seed[] = match @Maybe { none => @Fallback some held => @held }
 const Alias: Seed[] = @Source
 const Mapped: Shape[] = for item in @Alias { Shape(p: segment(start: (0, 0), end: (@item.n, 0)), n: @item.n + 2) }
 const Chosen: Shape = @Mapped[0]
 export const out: path = @Chosen.p
 export const tag: number = @Chosen.n
 export const size: number = @Source.length
}
const P: path = segment(start: (0, 0), end: (3, 4))
const Q: path = segment(start: (0, 0), end: (5, 12))
instance One = Make(p: @P, q: @Q, n: 19, present: true)
instance Two = Make(p: @P, q: @Q, n: 43, present: false)
const First: path = @One::out
const Second: path = @Two::out
const L: number = @First.length
const M: number = @Second.length
const X: number = @First.endPoint.x
const Y: number = @Second.endPoint.x
const N: number = @One::tag
const O: number = @Two::tag
const C: number = @One::size
const D: number = @Two::size

const Ticks: number[] = [1, 2]
const Once: number[] = [9]
for Tick in @Ticks carry Left: number[] = [2, 7] carry Right: number[] = [11, 13, 17] {
 for InnerTick in @Once carry A: number[] = @Left carry B: number[] = @Right {
  const Shifted: number[] = for Item in @A { @Item + @Tick }
  next A = @B
  next B = @Shifted
 }
 next Left = @A
 next Right = @B
}
const L0: number = @Left[0]
const L1: number = @Left[1]
const R0: number = @Right[0]
const R2: number = @Right[2]
const LL: number = @Left.length
const RL: number = @Right.length

line Seed = polyline(points: [(0, 0), (3, 0), (3, 4)], closed: false)
move Seed as shifted (from: (0, 0), to: (5, 7))
move Seed as later (from: (0, 0), to: (100, 200))
const Start: path[] = [@Seed.shifted]
for Tick in range(min: 0, max: 1, step: 1) carry Paths: path[] = @Start carry End: point = @Seed.base.end {
 const Selected: path = @Paths[0]
 point Incoming = from(source: @Selected.end)
 next End = @Selected.end
 next Paths = [@Seed.base]
}
point Observed = from(source: @End)
